standard_prerequisites: Path concatenation p concat q and path inversion (opposite p) as operations on the identity types of a type A, each with its definitional behaviour on refl.

The induction principle for identity types (path induction) with its conversion rule: to prove a statement about all paths it suffices to prove it for refl, and the proof term then computes on refl by definition.
Iterated identity types: the laws asserted are themselves propositional equalities, that is, elements of identity types of identity types (paths of paths).
core_obligations: Prove the unit laws: p equals p concat refl y and p equals refl x concat p for every path p in x = y.
Prove the inverse laws: opposite p concat p equals refl y and p concat opposite p equals refl x.
Prove involution: opposite of opposite p equals p.
Prove associativity: p concat (q concat r) equals (p concat q) concat r.
Carry out each item by path induction, verifying the definitional conversion in the reflexivity case.
proof_roadmap: Item on unit laws: define the type family D(x, y, p) = (p = p concat refl y); its reflexivity instance is (refl x = refl x concat refl x), which is definitionally (refl x = refl x); inhabit it by refl of refl and apply path induction; the mirrored law is proven the same way.

Item on inverse laws: with D(x, y, p) = (opposite p concat p = refl y), the reflexivity instance reduces definitionally to (refl x = refl x) since opposite of refl is refl and concatenation of refl with refl is refl; inhabit by refl of refl and apply path induction.
Item on involution: with D(x, y, p) = (opposite of opposite p = p), the reflexivity instance reduces definitionally to (refl x = refl x); inhabit by refl of refl and apply path induction.

Item on associativity: build three nested type families D1, D2, D3 so that the reflexivity instance of D3 reduces definitionally to (refl x = refl x); inhabit it by refl of refl and apply path induction three times.
Each item also admits the concise second induction argument exhibited by the author inside the same proof; the retained text includes both styles for every item.
difficulty_reason: Four separate induction proofs, one of them (associativity) needing three nested type families; each individual step is routine but the card carries the full omega-groupoid coherence checklist with conversion checks.
